```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "01-population", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Recruitment accounting

```{r}
#| label: recruitment-summary

recruitment <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-recruitment.parquet")
)

randomized <- recruitment |>
  filter(!is.na(randomization_date), group_assignment %in% c(0, 1))

recruitment_summary <- tibble(
  step = c(
    "randomized_total",
    "selected_for_invitation",
    "not_selected",
    "enrolled"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(randomized),
    sum(randomized$group_assignment == 1),
    sum(randomized$group_assignment == 0),
    sum(!is.na(randomized$informed_consent_date))
  )
)

write_parquet(
  recruitment_summary,
  here(results_dir, "recruitment-summary.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-recruitment
#| tbl-cap: "Aggregate recruitment accounting"
#| echo: false

recruitment_summary |>
  kable()
```

## Cumulative recruitment

```{r}
#| label: recruitment-cumulative

# Acceptance is a subset of the ctDNA group: same colour, dotted line.
recruitment_colors <- c(
  "Randomized comparison (total)" = "grey50",
  "ctDNA" = group_colours[["ctDNA"]],
  "Accepted invitation" = group_colours[["ctDNA"]]
)
recruitment_linetypes <- c(
  "Randomized comparison (total)" = "solid",
  "ctDNA" = "solid",
  "Accepted invitation" = "13"
)

recruitment_events <- bind_rows(
  randomized |>
    transmute(date = randomization_date, group = "Randomized comparison (total)"),
  randomized |>
    filter(group_assignment == 1) |>
    transmute(date = randomization_date, group = "ctDNA"),
  randomized |>
    filter(group_assignment == 1, !is.na(informed_consent_date)) |>
    transmute(date = informed_consent_date, group = "Accepted invitation")
)

stopifnot(nrow(recruitment_events) > 0)

plot_dates <- seq(
  min(recruitment_events$date) - 1,
  max(recruitment_events$date),
  by = "day"
)

recruitment_cumulative <- recruitment_events |>
  count(group, date) |>
  complete(
    group = names(recruitment_colors),
    date = plot_dates,
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  ) |>
  arrange(group, date) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  mutate(cumulative_n = cumsum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = names(recruitment_colors)))
```

```{r}
#| label: recruitment-plot

recruitment_plot <- ggplot(
  recruitment_cumulative,
  aes(date, cumulative_n, colour = group, fill = group, linetype = group)
) +
  geom_area(position = "identity", alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = filter(recruitment_cumulative, n > 0), size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 150, linetype = "dashed", colour = reference_line_colour) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(plot_dates),
    y = 150,
    label = "Uptake target: 150",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = -0.6,
    colour = reference_line_colour,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = recruitment_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = recruitment_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = recruitment_linetypes, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    breaks = breaks_width(50),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative number of patients",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  recruitment_plot,
  here(results_dir, "recruitment-cumulative.svg"),
  height = 4.5
)
```

#| label: fig-recruitment
